title: Atemporality

source.dataset: psychonautwiki_db.zip (psychonautwiki.db, SQLite export provided by Hany, file dated 2026-11-25)

plain_text:
Atemporality is a complex form of distortion in which the user is not effected by time in their perception. This can be caused by a very disconnected state or a very amnesticized state. In this situation the person is disconnected from time meaning that they skip time essentially, because they simply cant remember. In this situation after the user administers the substance that causes Atemporality from their perspective they essentially teleport into a new space. During that remaining time they likely did things and they probably had stuff happen to them but they cant remember. 

A good example of this would be an experience i heard from somebody i knew pretty well. Basically they where at work and really exhausted. And one of their good friends that also worked there gave him a pill and said this will wake you up. He took the pill and started to clean the kitchen. Now where the Atemporality kicks in is when He looked at the clock, looked back down, looked back up to the clock and saw that an hour had passed in a second. For the life of Him He could not remember what happened within that hour. And the clock didnt malfunction she got off work after an hour instead of the 2 hours before the atmeporality. As for the substance He took. He didnt know.

This is most likely caused by the blocking of the part of the brain that creates memories so when it becomes unblocked the person sees the new part of a setting he / she is in. This creates the illusion of teleporting.
